summary: Worker-2, worker-5, and worker-6 source-reviewed rework is complete for this DOI: all nine local Table 2 EC50 rows are represented, placeholder mechanism notes were replaced with ontology claims, and remaining uncertainty is preserved as cautions rather than open blocking rework.
adjudication_summary: Bounded local-source re-review reopened the handoff packet, XML/PDF text, locator index, figure captions, OA package inventory, supplementary indexes, and linked DRAMP rows. The source supports accepted_with_cautions rather than clean acceptance because database activity-scope conflicts and anticancer/mechanism-scope limitations remain explicit, but no blocking worker-2/5/6 ticket remains open.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet is adequate for bounded local review: XML, PDF text, OA package members, figure captions/images, and linked DRAMP rows were reopened; no supplementary assets were present in the local packet.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 repair retained with cautions: six linked DRAMP rows remain represented with status counts {'source_conflict': 4, 'source_verified': 2}; conflicts are preserved rather than hidden.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repair accepted with cautions: all nine Table 2 EC50 antiproliferative rows are present with raw values, units, target cell lines, assay context, and XML/PDF locators. These rows do not support antimicrobial MIC/MBC claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-5 repair accepted with cautions: direct mechanism claims are limited to p53 binding/competition and p53 reporter activation; G2/M arrest and senescence are recorded as phenotype-supported claims with figure/result locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: No blocking or major worker-2/5/6 rework remains after local-source repair; publication-grade status is accepted_with_cautions because database conflicts and mechanism/activity-scope cautions remain visible.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP rows for b-WT1-pTj and FITC-WT1-pTj retain Antimicrobial/Anticancer labels; local primary material supports WT1-pTj anticancer/antimelanoma activity but not antimicrobial activity or separate primary activity assays for the labeled probes.
Primary Table 1 supports FITC-WT1-pTj as a FITC-labeled peptide; DRAMP metadata lists free termini/no other modification and one linked row title uses p54 instead of p53.
Packet archive inventory contains article NXML/PDF and figures; supplementary_index.json and supplementary_tables.json show no supplementary assets or tables.
The repaired Table 2 rows are EC50 antiproliferative/cell-viability rows in cancer and fibroblast cell lines, not antimicrobial MIC/MBC rows.

Mechanism ontology is bounded to p53 binding/competition, p53 reporter activation, G2/M arrest, and senescence phenotype; automated membrane/protein-synthesis/nucleic-acid context notes were not retained as source-reviewed claims.
